Product:{\"sku\":\"7100118131\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
* This software is designed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch™ 2. It is not compatible with the Nintendo Switch™.
*Please note that a Nintendo Switch™ version of KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX is also available. To avoid duplicate purchases, please check your platform before buying.
*Save data from the Nintendo Switch™ version CAN be transferred to this Nintendo Switch™ 2 version; HOWEVER, save data from this Nintendo Switch™ 2 version CANNOT be transferred to the Nintendo Switch™ version.
*This product is also included in other bundle sets. Please ensure you do not purchase the same content more than once.
*Players who own KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- Cloud Version are eligible for a 50% discount for the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.

KINGDOM HEARTS -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX- is an essential collection of the first six stories in the KINGDOM HEARTS series, a collaboration between Disney and SQUARE ENIX. Wield the legendary Keyblade and unlock the true power of friendship as you explore Disney worlds and defend them from darkness.

<Featured Titles>
・KINGDOM HEARTS FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:Chain of Memories
・KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS 358/2 Days (HD cutscene compilation)
・KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
・KINGDOM HEARTS Re:coded (HD cutscene compilation)
